nodes.description: LlamaLottery.mint(address _to,uint256 _count) payable public sale mint gated by the saleIsOpen modifier; loops _mintAnElement and sets startingIndexBlock.
LlamaLottery.presaleMint(address _to,uint256 _count) payable presale mint; requires presale flag and MAX_PRESALE_ITEMS.
LlamaLottery.buyTicket(uint256 _count) payable external; credits publicNumOfUser[msg.sender] and curTicketId without minting.
LlamaLottery.claim() external; mints one NFT per claimable ticket for msg.sender via _safeMint and only afterwards updates totalClaimed.
LlamaLottery.mintReserve(address _to,uint256 _count) onlyOwner reserve mint up to MAX_ITEMS.
LlamaLottery.withdrawAll() payable; restricted to hardcoded w1/w2, performs two ETH transfers via _widthdraw.
LlamaLottery._widthdraw(address,uint256) private; performs an unchecked low-level call{value:} value transfer.
LlamaLottery.setStartingIndex() external; derives startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) pseudo-randomness.
LlamaLottery.emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() onlyOwner; lets the owner force startingIndexBlock to block.number.
LlamaLottery._mintAnElement(address) private; computes id from totalSupply() and calls _safeMint (external receiver callback).
LlamaLottery.price(uint256 _count) view; returns PRICE.mul(_count).
LlamaLottery.setMintPrice(uint256) onlyOwner; updates PRICE.
LlamaLottery.setSaleStatus(bool) onlyOwner; toggles the sale flag.
LlamaLottery.setPresaleStatus(bool) onlyOwner; toggles the presale flag.
LlamaLottery.pause(bool) onlyOwner; toggles the inherited Pausable state that gates transfers.
LlamaLottery.setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner; updates baseTokenURI used by _baseURI().
LlamaLottery.getUserClaimableTicketCount(address user) view; returns publicNumOfUser[user] - totalClaimed[user].
LlamaLottery.walletOfOwner(address) view; enumerates owned token ids.
LlamaLottery._beforeTokenTransfer override; chains ERC721/Enumerable/Pausable hooks (paused check).
LlamaLottery constructor(string baseURI); sets base URI, pauses, disables sale/presale and sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Low-level external call{value: _amount}("") inside _widthdraw; no reentrancy guard, state not protected around the transfer.
External onERC721Received callback triggered by ERC721._safeMint inside _mintAnElement; hands control to the recipient mid-transaction.
blockhash(startingIndexBlock) / block.number used as pseudo-randomness in setStartingIndex; miner-influenceable and predictable.
uint256 public curTicketId = 0; running ticket counter used as the effective mint counter.
mapping(address=>uint256) publicNumOfUser; tickets bought per address via buyTicket.
mapping(address=>uint256) totalClaimed; tickets already claimed, updated after external calls in claim().
uint256 public PRICE = 0.05 ether; mint price, changeable by owner via setMintPrice.
uint256 public REVEAL_TIMESTAMP; set from block.timestamp in the constructor and compared against block.timestamp in mint().
uint256 public startingIndexBlock; block number used to seed startingIndex randomness.
uint256 public startingIndex; revealed provenance offset derived from blockhash.
address private w1; hardcoded payout address receiving 75% in withdrawAll.
address private w2; hardcoded payout address receiving the remaining balance in withdrawAll.
bool private presale; gates presaleMint.
bool private sale; gates mint and buyTicket.
string public baseTokenURI; metadata base set by setBaseURI.
uint256 public constant MAX_ITEMS = 5000; supply cap checked in mint/buyTicket/mintReserve.
uint256 public constant MAX_MINT = 20; per-transaction public mint cap.
uint256 public constant MAX_PRESALE_ITEMS = 500; presale supply cap.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): controls mint recipients, claim accounting keys and withdraw authorization.
block.timestamp: used for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP setup and comparison in mint().
address _to parameter of mint().
uint256 _count parameter of mint().
address _to parameter of presaleMint().
uint256 _count parameter of presaleMint().
uint256 _count parameter of buyTicket().
address _to parameter of mintReserve().
uint256 _count parameter of mintReserve().
address _address parameter of _widthdraw(), the low-level call target.
uint256 _amount parameter of _widthdraw(), the value forwarded.
uint256 _price parameter of setMintPrice().
bool _status parameter of setSaleStatus().
bool _status parameter of setPresaleStatus().
bool val parameter of pause().
address user parameter of getUserClaimableTicketCount().
uint256 total = _totalSupply() local in mint().
uint256 total = _totalSupply() local in buyTicket().
uint256 total = _totalSupply() local in presaleMint().
uint256 total = _totalSupply() local in mintReserve().
uint256 numbersOfTickets cached in claim() before the mint loop.
uint256 id = totalSupply() local in _mintAnElement().
uint256 balance = address(this).balance local in withdrawAll().
bool success returned by the low-level call in _widthdraw().

edges.reason: claim() derives the mint recipient and totalClaimed key from msg.sender, so an attacker-controlled contract chooses the callback target.
claim() loops calling _mintAnElement for each claimable ticket.
_mintAnElement -> _safeMint performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient.
recipient onERC721Received callback returns control to the minting path before state is finalised.
recipient callback can re-enter claim() while totalClaimed has not been updated.
totalClaimed is written only after the whole mint loop, enabling repeated claims through reentrancy.
getUserClaimableTicketCount subtracts totalClaimed[user] from publicNumOfUser[user].
getUserClaimableTicketCount reads publicNumOfUser[user].
withdrawAll performs two value transfers through _widthdraw without a reentrancy guard.
_widthdraw performs the unchecked low-level call{value}.
the recipient fallback can re-enter _widthdraw / withdrawAll during the value transfer.
withdrawAll authorizes msg.sender against the hardcoded addresses w1 and w2.
withdrawAll sends 75% of the balance to the hardcoded w1 address.
withdrawAll sends the remaining balance to the hardcoded w2 address.
mint entry points pass a caller-influenced recipient into _mintAnElement / _safeMint.
mint() calls _mintAnElement in a loop.
presaleMint() calls _mintAnElement in a loop.
mintReserve() calls _mintAnElement in a loop.
onERC721Received callback can re-enter mint() before curTicketId is updated.
onERC721Received callback can re-enter presaleMint().
onERC721Received callback can re-enter mintReserve().
mint() computes total + _count against MAX_ITEMS and then curTicketId = total.add(_count).
buyTicket updates curTicketId with SafeMath.add after a bound check.
presaleMint updates curTicketId with SafeMath.add.
mintReserve updates curTicketId with SafeMath.add.
user-controlled _count feeds the unchecked bound expression total + _count.
user-controlled _count is added to curTicketId and publicNumOfUser.
presale _count is added to curTicketId after the MAX_PRESALE_ITEMS check.
MAX_ITEMS bounds the mint arithmetic.
MAX_MINT caps _count in mint().
MAX_MINT caps _count in buyTicket().
MAX_PRESALE_ITEMS caps the presale supply arithmetic.
mintReserve adds owner-supplied _count to total and checks MAX_ITEMS.
price() = PRICE.mul(_count).
mint() requires msg.value >= price(_count).
buyTicket() requires msg.value >= price(_count).
presaleMint() requires msg.value >= price(_count).
setMintPrice overwrites PRICE.
owner-supplied _price is assigned to PRICE.
presaleMint requires the owner-controlled presale flag.
mint requires the owner-controlled sale flag.
buyTicket requires the owner-controlled sale flag.
setSaleStatus onlyOwner toggles the sale flag.
setPresaleStatus onlyOwner toggles the presale flag.
owner-supplied _status is written by setSaleStatus.
owner-supplied _status is written by setPresaleStatus.
owner-supplied val selects pause versus unpause.
pause() toggles the Pausable state that _beforeTokenTransfer enforces on every transfer/mint.
arbitrary user address is used to look up claimable tickets.
mint() decides reveal by comparing block.timestamp to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is the timestamp-dependent gate for startingIndexBlock.
constructor seeds REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp, which is miner-influenced.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = block.timestamp + 7 days.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive randomness.
startingIndex is derived from blockhash of a predictable block.
blockhash/block.number pseudo-randomness can be ground or miner-controlled.
setStartingIndex executes the blockhash-based randomness operation.
the owner can unilaterally overwrite startingIndexBlock, biasing the eventual random index.
mint() caches _totalSupply() in local total.
buyTicket() caches _totalSupply() in local total.
presaleMint() caches _totalSupply() in local total.
mintReserve() caches _totalSupply() in local total.
claim() caches the claimable count before the external-call minting loop.
_mintAnElement computes id from totalSupply() before _safeMint.
withdrawAll caches address(this).balance before transferring.
_widthdraw captures the success flag of the low-level call and only then requires it.
public caller supplies the _to mint recipient.
public caller supplies the _to presale recipient.
owner supplies the _to reserve recipient.
_address becomes the target of the low-level value call.
_amount becomes the value forwarded in the low-level call.

normalization_plan.reason: the _to parameter of mint() only feeds the mint entry point and should be folded into it.
the _count parameter of mint() is only used by mint() arithmetic.
the _to parameter of presaleMint() only feeds that function.
the _count parameter of presaleMint() is only used by presaleMint().
the _count parameter of buyTicket() is only used by buyTicket().
the _to parameter of mintReserve() only feeds mintReserve().
the _count parameter of mintReserve() is only used by mintReserve().
_address is the call target of the unsafe low-level value transfer.
_amount is the value forwarded by the unsafe low-level call.
_price only feeds setMintPrice().
_status only feeds setSaleStatus().
_status only feeds setPresaleStatus().
val only feeds pause().
user is only used by getUserClaimableTicketCount().
local total is a temporary of mint() and has no independent meaning.
local total is a temporary of buyTicket().
local total is a temporary of presaleMint().
local total is a temporary of mintReserve().
numbersOfTickets is the cached claim amount inside claim(); its stale value under reentrancy belongs to claim().
local id is the token id computed inside _mintAnElement().
local balance is the cached contract balance inside withdrawAll().
local success is the low-level call result checked inside _widthdraw().
